periods.time: vol-17 ch-002, final day of the Vermillion-Quedland war

name.zh: 一辉对艾莉丝：剑神诞生
name.en: Ikki versus Alice: birth of the Sword God

periods.summary: After Alice attacks Stella to protect Or-Gaule, Ikki orders Stella to pursue Or-Gaule and stays behind to fight Alice. Ikki's techniques initially cannot overcome Invincible Armor, while Alice's Regeneration Overdose makes her faster and stronger with each self-damaging swing. Ikki survives by reading her patterns and deliberately turning the battle into a time trap: Alice can win if she keeps pressing safely, but every passing minute risks Or-Gaule dying to Stella. Forced by her desire to save her brother, Alice chooses a decisive clash. Ikki activates Ittou Rasetsu and uses the final secret sword Oikage, a strike whose accumulated history and Desperado gravity fixes the result of cutting. It slices through Invincible Armor and Alice's body. Regeneration Overdose then destroys her now-unsupported body. Ikki holds Alice as she dies, promises not to forget the gentle knight who fought for family, and his victory over the League's fourth-ranked A-rank knight earns him the title Sword God.
periods.cause: Alice betrays the Vermillion side to save Or-Gaule, and Ikki must prevent her from interfering with Stella's pursuit.
periods.outcome: Alice dies; Ikki wins but exhausts his magic and body; his global reputation rises from student champion to League main-force level.
casualties: alice-ascaride killed by Oikage and Regeneration Overdose self-destruction
periods.significance: Defines Ikki's new Sword God reputation and removes Alice as Or-Gaule's protector, but also pushes Ikki into the final battle with almost no remaining resources.
